summary: Complete-source extraction for a synthetic S2 indoor-logistics sensor product and pricing website, covering launch, conditional temperature accuracy and battery life, sampling, qualified pilot results, Basic and Team first-year pricing, deployment order, and the caption-supported assembly video.

facts.text: The supplied source is a synthetic evaluation example, not a real company.
Lumen Labs launched the S2 sensor in March 2025 for indoor logistics.
The S2 sensor's temperature range is 0–50 °C. Its stated accuracy is ±0.3 °C only at 10–35 °C.
The S2 sensor samples every 30 seconds.
The replaceable battery lasts up to 18 months at 20 °C; this battery-life claim does not apply at all temperatures.
No outdoor certification is provided for the S2 sensor.
A non-randomized May 2025 pilot at 24 sites reported median processing time 18% lower, excluding installation/setup time. This result applies to the pilot and is not a guaranteed customer outcome.
The vendor claims simpler maintenance; no independent maintenance study is supplied.
Basic costs USD 240 annually for the first year only, supports up to 10 seats, and includes CSV export. Tax and setup are excluded.
Team costs USD 480 annually for the first year only, supports up to 30 seats, and includes CSV and JSON export. Tax and setup are excluded.

Deployment sequence: calibrate before attaching the sensor; pair over Bluetooth; then confirm a timestamped sample. The supplied assembly demonstration video's caption explicitly shows calibration and pairing.

limitations: The source is explicitly synthetic and must not be represented as evidence about a real company.
Pricing is specified for the first year only; subsequent-year prices are not supplied.
The pilot is non-randomized, excludes installation/setup time, and does not establish a guaranteed customer outcome.
No independent maintenance study or outdoor certification is supplied.
No product photograph is supplied. The assembly video's association is based on the supplied caption; its visual contents were not independently inspected.
